notes: Fixes: the engineer no longer answers in English when another language is selected; invalidated laps are no longer announced as your fastest lap; far less repetition during races (weather, flags, battle and tyre callouts); iRacing now correctly detects Practice / Qualifying / Race; LMU no longer warns about cars parked in the garage; the overlay stays on top of the game (borderless mode); the microphone auto-recovers if your selected mic was unplugged; safer speech-model downloads; settings now save reliably even when Windows or your antivirus blocks the normal folder.
